binds-identity action discriminator on Mishpat::Commitment (DNA-hash-neutral coordinator hot-swap): declares chain head=key K, controllers={set}, controller-policy = self | Steward-set | RecoveryAuthority M-of-N; reuse RecoveryRequest/RecoveryAuthority for the human quorum

REA agent re-pointing (§4.1): populate rea_commitments.provider/receiver with a collective's chain-root cid when the party is a collective; reconcile SQLite collectives.id slug vs DHT content-CID via a dht_anchor_hash-style mirror column. No DNA work.

Contributor attribution re-pointing (§4.2): re-anchor claimed_agent_id / ClaimedAgentToPresence on the identity_head chain-root cid so a claim resolves through the chain and survives rotation; presence↔EPR edges + recognition accrual already rotation-safe

Witnessed binding (§4.3): sign the existing AgentPeerBinding (replace STAGE1_SIGNATURE_SENTINEL) via a challenge/response over the transport channel cross-signed by the head key; signed binding adds a verified alsoKnownAs transport-id to the head. NOT frame-witness.
